Score clusters against every candidate CeNGEN neuron type

Source: R/score.R
score_cengen_matrix.Rd

Computes a "dot-plot-mirrored coherence score" for each (cluster, neuron type) pair: how consistently the cluster's marker gene panel is both highly expressed (coverage, mirroring dot size) and specific (mirroring dot color) in that neuron type, relative to CeNGEN's other neuron types. This is the computational equivalent of visually judging whether a CeNGEN dot plot shows one neuron type standing out.

Usage

score_cengen_matrix(
  markers,
  reference,
  top_n = 20,
  min_pct_expr = 10,
  combine = c("geometric", "arithmetic"),
  cov_weight = 0.5,
  spec_weight = 0.5,
  cluster_col = "cluster",
  gene_col = "gene"
)

Arguments

markers

Either raw marker output (see prepare_marker_panel()) or an already-prepared panel (a data frame with cluster, gene, rank, n_used columns).

reference

A cengen_reference object (see new_cengen_reference() / load_cengen_reference()).

top_n, cluster_col, gene_col

Passed to prepare_marker_panel() when markers is not already a prepared panel.

min_pct_expr

Minimum percent-expressing (0-100) for a gene to count as "covered" in a neuron type; below this, coverage is 0.

combine

How to combine the coverage and specificity signals per gene: "geometric" (default) or "arithmetic".

cov_weight, spec_weight

Weights on the coverage and specificity signals (exponents for "geometric", linear weights for "arithmetic").

Value

A long tibble with columns cluster, neuron_type, score, n_genes_used, n_genes_requested, n_genes_missing_from_reference, n_genes_uninformative.

Details

For each gene g and neuron type t:

  • cov(g,t) = 0 if pct_expr(g,t) < min_pct_expr, else pct_expr(g,t) / 100.

  • z(g,t) = (avg_expr(g,t) - mu_g) / sigma_g, where mu_g/sigma_g are gene g's mean/sd of avg_expr across all neuron types. spec(g,t) = plogis(z(g,t)).

  • s(g,t) combines the two: for combine = "geometric" (default), cov(g,t)^cov_weight * spec(g,t)^spec_weight (requires both signals to be non-trivial simultaneously); for "arithmetic", cov_weight * cov(g,t) + spec_weight * spec(g,t).

The cluster-level score for neuron type t is the mean of s(g,t) over the cluster's usable marker genes. Genes absent from the reference, or with near-zero variance across neuron types (uninformative), are excluded from scoring and tallied in the diagnostic columns.
